correction: An earlier run reported 0.1415 for FC->cognition after partialling age+sex. That was a bug in the residualisation (it dropped the intercept term inconsistently). Re-run correctly: FC predicts age strongly (0.585) but age and cognition are nearly uncorrelated in HCP-YA (r=-0.042, N=974, ages 23.5-36), so removing age costs almost nothing: 0.6153 -> 0.6108.
conclusion: The connectome's cognitive signal is NOT an age proxy in this cohort. ~0.61 of the correlation survives controlling for age and sex.
